versions.content: If Bus Mirroring is enabled globally (see FrIfBusMirroringSupport), then call Fr_GetChannelStatus for all controllers of each FlexRay cluster for which mir- roring has been activated with a call to FrIf_EnableBusMirroring(), merge the states reported for the controllers of one cluster with a binary OR, and then call Mirror_Re- portFlexRayChannelStatus() with the cluster, Fr_ChannelAStatusPtr, and Fr_Channel BStatusPtr to report the aggregated channel states to the Bus Mirroring module.
